subject.title: fix(doctor): migrate legacy google provider config to current catalog schema (#102138)

question: Should maintainers accept this doctor-contract-only Google config migration as the canonical fix for the migration half of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102138, or choose a sibling implementation instead?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it mutates persisted provider config under doctor --fix and overlaps several open PRs for the same P0 upgrade bug, so the final canonical branch choice is maintainer-owned.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Land this PR after required checks finish if maintainers prefer the narrower Google doctor-contract-only fix and then close the sibling migration PRs as duplicates.

options.title: Choose sibling implementation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102170 or another sibling if maintainers prefer that test/registration shape, then close this PR after the canonical fix lands.

options.title: Fold in fallback behavior
options.body: Expand the chosen work to also fix fallback fast-fail behavior, but that broadens scope and needs separate live provider proof.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Land this PR after required checks finish if maintainers prefer the narrower Google doctor-contract-only fix and then close the sibling migration PRs as duplicates.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the recent Google plugin and doctor-contract refactor history that this migration plugs into.
